description: A night-time rainy city road packed with young people in dark clothes and face masks holding yellow and black umbrellas. Tents and stacked supplies sit along a central barrier, hazy spray drifts in the middle, and lit skyscrapers rise behind. Banners hang on a railing at left, including a yellow one with clearly painted Chinese characters. Painterly, edge to edge, no frame.
reason: Painted Chinese characters are visible on the yellow banner at the left edge, and the white banners beside it carry script-like marks. Repaint with blank banners or none.
